name: Ad-Manum Finance Limited
about: Ad-Manum Finance Limited provides non-banking financial services and engages in wind power generation in India. It operates through two segments: NBFC Activity and Power Generation business (Windmill). The NBFC Activity segment offers lending services. The Power Generation segment is involved in the generation of electricity through windmills. The company was formerly known as Agarwal Warehousing & Leasing Limited and changed its name to Ad-Manum Finance Limited in June 1992. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Indore, India.
